purpose: Deterministically reconstruct the full-fidelity quotation master from the tokenized payload and brand_assets.
token_format: {{GSSC_ASSET:<name>}} where <name> is a key of brand_assets
procedure: For each brand_assets entry, verify base64 decodes and its sha256 matches sha256_of_decoded_image.
Replace every {{GSSC_ASSET:name}} token with its replacement_value. Replace tokens only; never edit surrounding markup.
Confirm zero unresolved tokens remain and that no brand_assets entry went unused.
Compare the result against verification.hydrated_template_sha256. On mismatch, HARD STOP: do not deliver, do not partially repair.
The hydrated file is fully self-contained and renders offline with no external request.
hard_stops: An unresolved {{GSSC_ASSET:...}} token in any client-facing file.
An asset whose decoded hash does not match its declared value.
A hydrated digest that does not match verification.hydrated_template_sha256.

verification.round_trip_result: Hydrating the tokenized 2.16.1 template reproduces the built derivative byte-for-byte.
